title: Blood Cancer Projections (lymphoma): incidence and prevalence projections for Australia, 2022–2045
description:
R code, processed input data and modelled outputs for the manuscript Lymphoma incidence and prevalence projections in Australia to 2045: a statistical modelling study. Age-period-cohort incidence models (Hodgkin lymphoma and aggregate non-Hodgkin lymphoma fitted from 1990; diffuse large B-cell, follicular and mantle cell lymphoma from 2003) with parameter-level Monte Carlo credible intervals, and a counting-method prevalence model at 2-, 3-, 5-, 10- and 40-year durations, by sex, to 2045. Inputs are published aggregate statistics from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare and the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

Published results were produced with R 4.5.2 and Epi 2.61 (seed 20260507, 1,000 draws). code/reproduce.R re-runs the pipeline on a fresh download and compares it with the committed outputs. Code is released under the MIT licence; the processed data and modelled outputs under CC BY 4.0. A public dashboard of the projections is at https://che-monash.github.io/Blood-Cancer-Projections/.
